# Surogate

> Surogate is the European platform for AI colleagues, made by Invergent S.A.
> Alongside it: Surogate Desktop, Voice, Keel, the AI Gateway and the
> open-source engine we train our own models with, on your hardware or ours.
> Surogate, Keel and our models run in our EU cloud, in your cloud, on your own
> hardware or air-gapped. The AI Gateway is llm.buzz. Surogate sells directly
> and through partners.

## Products
- [Surogate](https://surogate.ai/surogate/): AI colleagues for every team. Design, test, govern and run agents without code, in your cloud or on your own hardware.
- [Surogate Desktop](https://surogate.ai/surogate-desktop/): Your Surogate agent, working on the files on your computer.
- [Voice](https://surogate.ai/voice/): Voice agents that listen and answer in real time, on speech models we train ourselves.
- [Keel](https://surogate.ai/keel/): Business processes that run agents. Stages, versioned decision rules, approval limits, audit and replay.
- [Train](https://surogate.ai/train/): Train and serve your own model on one open-source engine.
- [AI Gateway](https://surogate.ai/gateway/): llm.buzz, the open market for production inference. One key for every model; providers post their own prices and the router compares them on every request; 0% markup on provider prices; EU-only routing on every plan.

## Research
- [Research](https://surogate.ai/labs/): Our own models and the engine that trains them.
- Surogate 3.7 Flash: open weights, text and images in, 1M tokens of context, 32K of output, on [llm.buzz](https://llm.buzz/models/surogate/surogate3.7-flash).
- Surogate 3.5 2B, 4B and 9B: Romanian-first assistants with thinking in Romanian and English, Apache 2.0, on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/surogate).
- [Surogate Rune](https://surogate.ai/labs/rune/): an open decision model for text and images. 26B parameters, 4B active; second on the Decision Index 0.2.1 (26 September 2026).
- [Surogate Speech](https://surogate.ai/labs/speech/): Jackrabbit (speech recognition, 5.69% word error rate on the FLEURS Romanian test) and Amami (text to speech).
- [Surogate Engine](https://surogate.ai/labs/engine/): training and serving on native C++/CUDA, Apache 2.0. 2.53x the training throughput of Unsloth on one H100; 7.0x the serving throughput of llama.cpp at 16 users on 8 RTX 5090s.
- [Rune at work](https://surogate.ai/labs/rune-examples/): the Rune demos, filmed.

## Pricing facts
- Individual plans: Free, Standard $19, Pro $96, Max $190 a month.
- Pilot: $0 for the first 60 days of every new client.
- Production: $990 a month per client organisation ($940 billed yearly). Up to 1,000 agents working at once.
- Scale: $2,990 a month per client organisation ($2,840 billed yearly). Up to 5,000 agents working at once; single sign-on, roles and audit logs.
- Keel on Surogate cloud: $0.20 per completed case for the first 10,000 a month, $0.10 up to 100,000, $0.05 beyond.
- Models: bring your own provider and pay it directly, or use llm.buzz at the provider's price.
